verdict: Leads and cost per lead moved the wrong way this week.
narrative: Over the last 28 days you received 95 leads at a cost of $19.18 per lead, but the most recent 7-day window shows the trend softening: leads fell 10.71% and cost per lead rose 16.32% week-over-week, with the last three days of the period confirming that pressure is building on Meta. At the same time, Google Business Profile activity dropped sharply in the final days of the window, and two locations — Weston and Dr Phillips — are drawing impressions without converting them into calls at the rate your other locations do. Ad creative is being refreshed this week to counter the Meta cost trend, and the GBP listings for underperforming locations are under active review. Next period you should see cost per lead begin to stabilize as the creative rotation takes effect and the listing issues are resolved.
